description: US-46 — MORE FILTERS ON THE CUSTOMER LIST. Four new filters join the GET filter form on /kunden, ANDed with Suche/Status/Gruppe/Bedarfsnachweis/archived: Erwachsene and Kinder (Excel-style checkbox dropdowns over the counts that occur, OR within a list, all ticked = unset, none ticked = empty table), Letzte Ausgabe vor (lastHandoutAt strictly before a day; never-served households never match) and Nachweis endet vor (validUntil strictly before a day). All in the URL (erwachsene, kinder, ausgabe-vor, nachweis-vor), named in the filter summary, cleared by reset. Source: tasks/prd-us-46-more-customer-list-filters.md. Out of scope (PRD §Non-Goals): export/print/extra columns, date sorting, per-box counts, age/size filters, „between", any filter on /ausgabe. No schema change, port method, audit entry or ADR. Both e2e engines stay green.

userStories.title: listCustomers narrows by latest hand-out and certificate end
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want to list the households not served since a given day, or whose certificate ends before a given day, so I can find who no longer comes and who needs to renew. Source: tasks/prd-us-46-more-customer-list-filters.md §US-46.1
acceptanceCriteria: ListCustomersInput (src/application/customers/list-customers.ts) gains optional lastHandoutBefore?: Date and certificateEndsBefore?: Date; absent = not filtered

lastHandoutBefore keeps a household whose lastHandoutAt falls on a UTC calendar day (the day germanDate prints) strictly before the given day; a hand-out ON the day does not qualify, one the day before does
A household with lastHandoutAt === null is never kept by lastHandoutBefore, whatever the day
lastHandoutBefore reads the latestHandoutByCustomer() map already loaded for the column — no new query, no new port method
certificateEndsBefore keeps a household whose current certificate's validUntil lies strictly before midnight UTC of the given day: one ending 30.11. is kept under 01.12., not under 30.11.

certificateEndsBefore goes to the store inside the existing ValidUntilRange (a WHERE clause). A pure domain function in src/domain/customer/certificate.ts, written test-first (e.g. endingBefore(range: ValidUntilRange | undefined, day: Date): ValidUntilRange), intersects it with the certificate-state range: the earlier `before` wins, `from` is kept; `before` is utcDay(day), never a time of day
A future day is accepted by both filters
Both filters AND with every existing filter and with each other; sorting by customer number and groupCounts are unchanged; no audit entry

Tests written first, one named test per rule, e.g. `keeps a household served the day before`, `drops a household served on the day itself`, `never keeps a household never served`, `keeps a certificate ending the day before, not one ending on the day`, `intersects with the certificate state, the earlier end winning`; the domain function has day-before / day-of / day-after and a 29 February boundary test
Full unit suite passes with coverage (domain and application stay at 100%): npm run test:coverage
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Application + domain only; no src/app change in this story. ls src/domain/customer/certificate.ts before editing — it holds isExpired, certificateState, validUntilRangeFor already.

userStories.title: listCustomers narrows by grown-up and child counts and lists the counts that occur
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want to tick which numbers of grown-ups and of children to show, so I can find the large families, the households without children, and so on. Source: tasks/prd-us-46-more-customer-list-filters.md §US-46.2
acceptanceCriteria: ListCustomersInput gains grownUps?: ReadonlyArray<number> and children?: ReadonlyArray<number>. Absent = not filtered; present = exactly these counts, OR within one list; an EMPTY array matches nothing — the one place the list does not follow statusesFor's „empty means all"; the field's doc comment says so. statusesFor itself is not changed

Compared against the row's grownUps / children — the „Erw. + Kinder" column's numbers, from composition(members, today) with the use case's single today; applied in the use case after composition, the way `group` already is

CustomerListView gains grownUpCounts and childCounts: ReadonlyArray<number>, the distinct counts that occur, ascending, over every ACTIVE and BLOCKED household plus ARCHIVED ones only when includeArchived is true — independent of search, status, group, certificate, the day filters and the count filters themselves
Any count named in the request's own grownUps / children is also in the matching list, even when no household has it any more (PRD §Open Questions 1)
The occurring counts come from ONE extra customers.list({ statuses }) and composition() per household — not one query per household, and not via describeAllowances
groupCounts and sorting unchanged; no audit entry; no new port method

Tests first against the hand-written fakes, one per rule, e.g. `lists the children counts that occur, ascending`, `leaves archived households out of the listed counts unless they are shown`, `does not narrow the listed counts by the other filters`, `shows only the ticked counts`, `shows nothing when no count is ticked`, `counts a child who turns 13 today as a grown-up`, `keeps a filtered count listed after its last household left`
Full unit suite passes with coverage (domain and application stay at 100%): npm run test:coverage
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Application only; no src/app change in this story (the page still compiles — the new view fields are simply unread until US-004).

userStories.title: „Letzte Ausgabe vor" and „Nachweis endet vor" day fields on /kunden
userStories.description: As a staff member on /kunden, I want two day fields in the filter form, so I can apply the day filters from the screen and pass the view on as a link. Source: tasks/prd-us-46-more-customer-list-filters.md §US-46.3

Two fields labelled „Letzte Ausgabe vor" and „Nachweis endet vor" (de.ts), each the existing DateInput (src/components/ui/date-input.tsx), uncontrolled with defaultValue from the URL, wrapped in FilterField (real <label htmlFor>), with the placeholder DateInput uses elsewhere

URL parameters `ausgabe-vor` and `nachweis-vor` carry the text as typed (ausgabe-vor=01.10.2026); parsed in the page's Zod schema with parseCalendarDay; empty/absent = not filtered; passed to listCustomers as lastHandoutBefore / certificateEndsBefore

userStories.title: „Erwachsene" and „Kinder" checkbox dropdowns on /kunden
userStories.description: As a staff member on /kunden, I want two Excel-style checkbox dropdowns, so I can apply the count filters from the screen and see at a glance, collapsed, whether one is set. Source: tasks/prd-us-46-more-customer-list-filters.md §US-46.4
acceptanceCriteria: Two dropdowns „Erwachsene" and „Kinder" in the second filter row, one checkbox per count in view.grownUpCounts / view.childCounts, labelled with the number alone; no household counts beside the boxes

Native <details>/<summary> with native <input type="checkbox"> inside — NOT Radix DropdownMenu (it portals out of the <form>, so its boxes would submit nothing). The form stays a server component with no JS of its own; the open panel is absolutely positioned above the content and the sticky table header, and keyboard-operable
A tick takes effect only on „Filtern"; default and reset = every box ticked = not filtered
URL parameters `erwachsene` and `kinder`, repeated per ticked count (kinder=1&kinder=7); absent = not filtered; non-integer values dropped; a parameter with no readable value left = not filtered

Each dropdown also submits a hidden <input name="kinder" value="keine"> (resp. erwachsene). `kinder=keine` alone = no box ticked = empty table with de.customerList.empty.filtered naming the filters — never „show everything"

The page redirects (next/navigation redirect) to the canonical URL when the count parameters differ from it: the sentinel is dropped when any count is ticked; a list with EVERY listed box ticked is removed entirely so the URL carries nothing for it. Only erwachsene/kinder are rewritten; every other parameter passes through as submitted, an unreadable day's text included

The collapsed <summary> reads „Kinder: alle" (unset), „Kinder: 1, 7" (set), „Kinder: keine" (none ticked), likewise „Erwachsene: …", reflecting the filter in force (the URL), not unsubmitted ticks. A set dropdown also gets a coloured border from an existing accent token (src/app/accents.ts / guide §5) — text and colour together, never colour alone

The filter summary and empty-state message name a set dropdown in the label's words („Kinder: 1, 7", „Kinder: keine") via new de.customerList.filterClauses entries, ordered Erwachsene, Kinder, then the day filters, then the archived clause; an unset dropdown is not named
Every new string in src/i18n/de.ts; no hint text in or beside the dropdowns
No horizontal overflow at 1100px and GATE_WIDTH; the open panel is not clipped by the card; closed, it covers nothing (expectNothingCovers on the first table row)

e2e in tests/e2e/customer-list.spec.ts: only occurring counts are listed; ticking „Archivierte Haushalte anzeigen" adds an archived-only count; status/group filters do not change the boxes; unticking 0 under Kinder + „Filtern" shows only households with children with matching summary and collapsed label; unticking every box shows the empty message naming „Kinder: keine"; re-ticking every box + „Filtern" leaves no kinder in the URL and the label reads „Kinder: alle"; the filter survives a reload; reset ticks every box again
npm run test:e2e AND npm run test:e2e:webkit pass (stop any leftover next dev / next start first)
Driven and reviewed with the playwright-cli skill (accessibility snapshot, not only a screenshot): both dropdowns closed, open, set and with every box unticked, at desktop width and at 1100px
Full unit suite passes with coverage (domain and application stay at 100%): npm run test:coverage
